property.name: Seabreeze Harbour Hotel
property.tagline: A quiet harbour-front stay in Fort Kochi

location.address: 17 Bastion Quay, Fort Kochi, Kerala 682001, India
location.landmark: A 4-minute walk from the Chinese Fishing Nets

policies.early_check_in: Subject to availability. Guaranteed early check-in can be pre-booked for INR 1,500.
policies.late_check_out: Until 1:00 PM is complimentary when the room is free; later than that is charged as a half-day.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the check-in date. Cancellations inside 48 hours are charged one night's room rate.
policies.no_show: A no-show is charged the full first night.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Under-6s stay free using existing bedding.
policies.extra_bed: One extra bed can be added to most rooms for INR 900 per night.
policies.pets: We are not able to accommodate pets, with the exception of registered service animals.
policies.smoking: All rooms are non-smoking. Smoking is permitted only in the courtyard area.
policies.id_requirement: A government-issued photo ID is required at check-in for every adult guest.

amenities.name: Outdoor swimming pool
amenities.detail: Open 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM, heated in winter.

amenities.name: Rooftop restaurant
amenities.detail: Harbour Table serves Kerala and continental dishes, 7:00 AM to 10:30 PM.

amenities.name: Breakfast
amenities.detail: A South Indian and continental buffet is served 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

amenities.name: Free Wi-Fi
amenities.detail: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property.

amenities.name: Fitness room
amenities.detail: A compact gym with cardio machines and free weights, open 24 hours.

amenities.name: Spa
amenities.detail: Ayurvedic treatments by appointment, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

amenities.name: Airport shuttle
amenities.detail: A private shuttle to Cochin International Airport can be arranged for INR 1,800 each way.

amenities.name: On-site parking
amenities.detail: Free self-parking is available for in-house guests.

amenities.name: Laundry
amenities.detail: Same-day laundry and pressing service, charged per item.

room_types.name: Harbour Twin
room_types.description: A bright room with two single beds and a partial harbour view.

room_types.name: Courtyard Queen
room_types.description: A quiet queen room overlooking the inner courtyard.

room_types.name: Backwater Suite
room_types.description: A spacious suite with a separate sitting area and a full harbour view. Comfortable for a small family.
room_types.beds: One king bed plus a sofa bed

room_types.name: Family Loft
room_types.description: A two-level loft that sleeps a larger family, with a kitchenette.
room_types.beds: One king bed and two single beds

faqs.answer: Breakfast is served as a buffet from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM at our rooftop restaurant. It is included with the Courtyard Queen, Backwater Suite and Family Loft rates; for the Harbour Twin it can be added for INR 650 per person.
Yes, free self-parking is available on-site for guests staying with us.
Reception is staffed 24 hours, so a late arrival is no problem. Just let us know your rough arrival time so we can keep the room ready.

questions: how do i get from the airport
faqs.answer: Cochin International Airport is roughly 40 km away, about 60 to 75 minutes by road. We can arrange a private shuttle for INR 1,800 each way if you book it in advance.
